chapter: Arranging career and the JPJ Quartet
title: Atlantic Records, Ruth Brown and Sarah Vaughan dates
summary: Budd was musical director at Atlantic, wrote 'Teardrops from My Eyes' for Ruth Brown, and arranged a date when Sarah Vaughan's arranger failed.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Have you got most of the guys that you recorded for, I mean that you made arrangements for, that you wrote for different guys?

Yeah. With Atlantic Records I was writing, and I was musical director for Atlantic Records, and at that time Ruth Brown was their feature artist, and I wrote this thing Tear Drops Keep Falling From My Eyes, which was a big over a million seller.

And of course I used to write for the different groups and rock groups and everything, for Decca and RCA, and with Hines Heines I wrote many, many, many things. Jerome things, I did Summertime and all of that, I was the staff arranger, you know. And Sarah Vaughn, at one time she came into town and somebody was supposed to make the arrangements for a record date for her and they didn't even show up with the music. So she called me. At that time I had an office downtown, I was in 1650 Broadway, and sharing an office
